Maintenance

Keep the lake small and fast.

MergeExpireClean upCHECKPOINT
Why maintenance

Merge, expire, clean up

1
Merge adjacent files
many small files become a few bigger ones
2
Expire snapshots
versions you will never travel back to
3
Clean up old files
files no snapshot uses any more
CHECKPOINT runs them all, following the lake's options.

Careful

Some steps cannot be undone

Expire and clean up
For good
no more time travel to expired snapshots; deleted files are gone
Orphaned files
ducklake_delete_orphaned_files
files no snapshot ever knew, e.g. after a crash

Recap

What to remember

1
Merge small files.
2
Expire snapshots you don't need.
3
Clean up, or just run CHECKPOINT.
4
Expiring ends time travel to those versions.
